memberships.page_title: The Categorical Quotient of Bounded Cubic Frames

statement: At ambient bound N, degree-preserving cubic-frame root translations are exactly the kernel pair of (Qhat,P) mapping to (Qhat,z^N P mod Qhat); when roots escape to infinity, P decomposes uniquely into finite-root data plus the translated principal part.
title: One Polynomial Map Encodes Every Bounded Root-Translation Orbit
